LESSON: HYGIENE DURING PUBERTY

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 10
Subject: HOME SCIENCE
Strand: Home Management
Topic 2.1: Hygiene During Puberty
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 4

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Hygiene During Puberty, part of Home Management in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 10 HOME SCIENCE.

Key inquiry question: How is hygiene maintained during puberty?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. explain personal hygiene practices during puberty,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Hygiene During Puberty in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. identify infections and diseases associated with poor personal hygiene,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Hygiene During Puberty in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

C. apply personal hygiene practices during puberty,

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Hygiene During Puberty in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

D. appreciate the importance of personal hygiene during puberty.

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Hygiene During Puberty in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Hygiene During Puberty together.

3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Communication and Collaboration: Learner speaks clearly when discussing the changes that occur in boys and girls during

puberty.

● Self-efficacy: The learner documents their success in carrying out hygiene practices by preparing and maintaining a log.

Values:
● Respect: Learner understands and respects others as they discuss measures for managing menstrual hygiene.

● Responsibility: The learner engages in assigned roles by preparing and maintaining a daily log on personal hygiene

practices carried out during puberty.

(PCIs):

Self-awareness: Learners become aware of themselves as they discuss the changes that occur in boys and girls during puberty,

and how they can maintain hygiene during this stage.
